name: Akebi Saki
source:
Saki is a first year student and know about Tatsuya from when he studied with her mother. When she sees a mural he painted, she immediately recognises his art style and begs him to tutor her in art. 
Whilst Saki is an extremely bright and sensible girl, she can sometimes show a childish, emotional side when upset.
translation:
Saki is a first year student and know about Tatsuya from when he studied with her mother. When she sees a mural he painted, she immediately recognises his art style and begs him to tutor her in art. 
Whilst Saki is an extremely bright and sensible girl, she can sometimes show a childish, emotional side when upset.
